distribution.summary: 广西；海南；山西；云南；香港；台湾
distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) records Guangxi and Yunnan. 黄复生等 (2015) retains those records. Smith et al. (2020) confirms Guangxi and Yunnan and adds Shanxi, Hong Kong and Taiwan. Lau (2025) provides additional secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong. Smith et al. (2022) confirms Guangxi, Hong Kong, Shanxi, Yunnan and Taiwan and adds Hainan, with locality evidence from Hainan, Qiongzhong.

host_note: Current host synthesis retains 殷蕙芬等 (1984)/黄复生等 (2015) hosts: Cassia siamea; Dryobalanops sp.; Quercus sp.; Castanopsis indica; Mallotus japonicus. Smith et al. (2022) adds Acacia mangium at species level.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xyleborus perforans (Wollaston, 1857).

taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Canonical identity follows integrated taxonomic backbone: Xyleborus perforans (Wollaston, 1857), VSN_6316. Beaver & Liu (2010) accepts Taiwan occurrence but explicitly flags the distinction from X. volvulus as unresolved/doubtful. This source-specific uncertainty is retained without merging VSN_6316 and VSN_6400.
